# DIRECTION — 03-passage-console

## Design thesis
Passage Log Console is not a generic product-ui template: first fold must make “log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes).” inevitable via real interface full width as first screen.

## Subject grounding
Subject: Passage Log Console
Audience: harbour masters logging vessel passages.
Primary action: log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes).
Brand palette cues: near-black shell, fog grey panels, amber for warnings only
Anti-references: consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome; consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome.

## Hierarchy
1) work object for Passage Log Console 2) required fields/states 3) log a passage (vessel, direction, time, notes). 4) validation/offline — no marketing chrome

## Signature
passage-log-work-canvas

## Primary risk
Must not drift into banned tropes (consumer fintech gradients, playful illustration chrome; consumer fintech gradie); signature may overfit if evidence is thin.

## Axis record

- direction-version: 2.3
- composition: real interface full width as first screen
- type: UI sans pair, tight tracking on tools
- colour: near-black shell, fog grey panels, amber for warnings only — brand evidence only; single reserved accent
- imagery: deliberately imageless — chrome and type carry the first screen
- rhythm: asymmetric tool rail + main canvas

- surface: framed — panels bound the work surface
- labels: symbol-led — tools speak as icons with text fallback
- figures: absent — no decorative metrics
- depth: inset — panels recede into the shell

- visual-density: 8
- motion-intensity: 1
- aesthetic-boldness: 3

- signature-selector: [data-signature="passage-log-work-canvas"]
- signature-min-share: 12

## Implementation notes
Composition: real interface full width as first screen
Type: UI sans pair, tight tracking on tools
Colour/material: near-black shell, fog grey panels, amber for warnings only — brand evidence only; single reserved accent
Imagery/assets: deliberately imageless — chrome and type carry the first screen
Interaction: keyboard-first primary journey
Do not invent testimonials, prices, awards, or assets not in the evidence pack.
Build context must not receive losing cards or generator scores.

## Rejections
- alternative card (W1): withheld from build
- alternative card (W2): withheld from build
